evals.title: Competing optional libraries
evals.prompt:
[Workspace state — read but do not narrate back:
- Pixi project; neither package is installed.
- The stack does not fix one canonical tuning library.]

Add either optuna or scikit-optimize for tuning. You choose.
evals.expected_output: Behavioural response satisfying: - Present the smallest useful comparison and ask the user to choose. - After a choice, route installation through `python -m skore_skills env add <package>`. It must NOT: - Install both candidates. - Pick silently because the user said “you choose.” - Run `pip install`.
